title: Appliance Repair Customer Completion Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Control diagnosis, repair, maintenance, testing, and return to use through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete appliance repair customer completion sign-off for appliances and utility connections. It connects manufacturer service information, approved scope, and customer authorization to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified appliance service technician and customer or authorized property contact must reconcile the promised appliance repair scope, actual work, evidence, limitations, remaining actions, and custody transfer.

sections.title: Appliance Repair completion, customer, site, and job identity
sections.guidance: Tie customer review to the exact job and receiving representative, not to an ambiguous signature line.

sections.title: Appliance Repair authorized scope and completed-work reconciliation
sections.guidance: Show what was approved, completed, changed, excluded, deferred, or declined before asking for acceptance.

Replace approved failed component

Update control setting or approved software configuration
Complete leak or pressure check
Restore utilities in the defined sequence
Run full or representative operating cycle
Provide use, care, and recurrence guidance

sections.title: Appliance Repair condition, tests, and evidence presented
sections.guidance: Present the actual observations and limitations supporting the completion claim.

blocks.label: Verification and condition results reviewed with the customer
items: Reported symptom no longer present under the test condition

Controls, indicators, and user interface respond correctly
Door, latch, interlock, guard, and cutoff operate correctly

Work area and customer contents restored
Customer operating limitation and next action explained

sections.title: Appliance Repair materials, charges, controlled items, and property custody
sections.guidance: Reconcile items and charges that materially affect customer ownership, security, operation, cleanup, or later service.

sections.title: Appliance Repair limitations, unresolved concerns, and callback plan
sections.guidance: Acceptance must not conceal a defect, incomplete task, service restriction, or promised follow-up.

blocks.label: Unresolved condition or follow-up trigger
items: Electrical shock, damaged conductor, or improper supply
Gas odor, fuel leak, combustion, carbon-monoxide, or venting concern
Refrigerant leak or work beyond technician certification
Water leak, overflow, sanitation, or property-damage risk
Hot surface, steam, pressure, sharp edge, or moving-part exposure
Appliance unstable, unanchored, or subject to tip-over
Required guard, interlock, cutoff, or safety device does not function
Recall, service bulletin, or incompatible replacement part concern
Customer requests operation before required testing is complete
Diagnosis remains uncertain or symptom cannot be reproduced safely

sections.title: Appliance Repair customer completion sign-off closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register
Final outcome, handoff, and record location

blocks.guidance: Use this appliance repair customer completion sign-off with the applicable customer agreement, manufacturer information, product instructions, site policy, licensing, safety, privacy, and retention requirements. It records the stated decision but does not create authority, coverage, compliance, or release when identity, evidence, scope, condition, or acceptance remains unresolved.
